# Demonhide Cloak · Book II, pp. 544–545
# Generated by the extractor — fix the extractor, not this file.
PAGE	544
FACE	front
TH	appendix d: major arcana
P	◇, 1 armor, <i>warm</i>, <i>magical</i>
P	A tattered cloak, stitched from a motley patchwork of unfamiliar hides and leather. Shifting odors waft from it: damp earth, ozone, musk, sulfur, rust, rot.
P	It is not a glamorous garment. Anything but.
HR
P	When you <b><i>wear the Cloak</i></b>, its armor applies against demons in all cases, even if their attacks are piercing or ignore armor.
P	When you <b><i>draw up the hood of the Cloak</i></b>, you see clearly in darkness.
P	When you <b><i>wrap the Cloak tightly about your person</i></b>, you pass unnoticed by all so long as you move calmly and carefully and keep out of direct, harsh light. In retrospect, those you pass may recall a strange smell.
P	When you <b><i>flay the hide from a demon, tan it, and sew it onto the cloak</i></b>, mark 1:
MARK	3
P	When you <b><i>make the last mark</i></b>, you unlock the mysteries of the Cloak and can use The Flesh Remembers (see reverse).

FACE	back
TH	appendix d: major arcana
H3	Mysteries of the Demonhide Cloak
HR
H2	Moves
HR
C	<b>THE FLESH REMEMBERS</b> When you <b><i>first encounter a demon and search the Cloak's memories for its like</i></b>, roll +nothing: <b>on a 10+</b>, the flesh of such a creature is present in the Cloak—you receive a vision of how it was defeated; <b>on a</b> <b>7-9</b>, choose 1 from the list below.
B	The flesh of such a creature is present in the Cloak—you receive a vision of how it was defeated, but mark a Consequence
B	The flesh of such a creature is not present in the cloak; you learn nothing
P	When you <b><i>have marked 3 Consequences</i></b>, you gain the following move:
HR
C	<b>UNHOLY VISAGE</b> ◇◇◇ When you <b><i>take the appearance of a demon</i></b>, roll +CON: <b>on a 10+</b>, hold 3 Guise; <b>on a 7-9</b>, hold 1 Guise; <b>on a 6-</b>, hold 1 Guise and mark a Consequence. While you hold Guise, all perceive you as a demon, and magic that affects demons affects you, too. Spend Guise, 1-for-1 to:
B	Maintain your appearance in the face of divination or revealing light
B	Understand any language you hear, and reply in kind
B	Shrug off harm that your demonic form could ignore
B	Maneuver in a way consistent with your demonic form: flying, leaping, oozing, flitting as a shadow, etc.
HR
H2	Consequences
HR
C	You experience an overwhelming vision, from the point of view of a demon sewn into the Cloak. Ask the GM what you see and when you come to.
C	A number of seams fray and tear. The Cloak loses its powers until you sew a new piece of demon flesh into it.
C	The Cloak's stench grows stronger, noticeable even when you go unseen and unheard. You smell faintly of the Cloak even when you aren't wearing it.
C	You become incapable of fear while wearing the Cloak. If you <b><i>wear the Cloak during a session</i></b>, your instinct becomes "Recklessness: To act with no regard to danger or consequence."
C	You begin to hear the voices of the dark creatures sewn into the Cloak. The Cloak becomes a follower (see below). When you would mark a Consequence, you can choose to spend 1 of the Cloak's Loyalty instead.
HR

H3	The Cloak
P	<i>bloodthirsty, demon-wise</i>, <i>extraordinary</i>, <i>magical</i>
P	<b>Cost</b> chaos and wanton destruction (Loyalty ◇◇◇ )
P	<b>Instinct</b> to bicker and argue (with you, with itself)
P	• Reveal a dark and terrible secret, or part of one
P	• Manifest a minor demonic effect
P	• Possess you in your sleep back
